outcome: Prevalence of age groups (e.g., reproductive age)
Distribution of previous mode of delivery
Prevalence of number of turns (e.g., one and two turns)
Prevalence of histopathological findings (e.g., simple serous cyst)
cohort: The study included all patients who underwent treatment for adnexal torsion at Saveetha Medical College between January 2023 and January 2024.
finding: The study found that adnexal torsion cases predominantly occurred in the reproductive age group (18-40 years), commonly presented with abdominal pain, and frequently revealed a simple serous cyst on histopathological examination.
